title: llamafactory: torch-load-unsafe @ v1/core/utils/checkpoint.py:136
install: pip install llamafactory==0.9.5 (wheel pinned; env venv-lfa)

root_cause.note: LLaMA-Factory v1 resume path restores RNG state with an explicit torch.load(weights_only=False) on <ckpt>/rng_state/rank_<n>.pt. Whoever can write the checkpoint directory (shared NFS, compromised peer rank, supply-chain mirror) gets pickle code execution the next time a victim resumes training. Reproduced at function level against the pinned upstream module from the real installed llamafactory 0.9.5 wheel; the sink itself is the real upstream torch.load call with weights_only=False on torch 2.14.

preconditions: attacker can write a LlamaFactory v1 training checkpoint directory
victim resumes training from that checkpoint (resume_from_checkpoint)
steps: craft a checkpoint dir whose rng_state/rank_0.pt is a pickled reducing payload
call the real upstream load_rng_state() and observe the marker inside torch.load
expected_evidence: marker written by the pickle payload inside the upstream torch.load call
run.json + log.txt with the pinned wheel sha256 and source hash
cleanup: temporary files under evidence/ are rewritten on every run
